text.description_html:
YKK Aluminum Store Front Door Offset Pivot Hinges

For new construction or replacement of YKK metal frame door hinges. Case hardened stud in floor pivot, easy to install.

Also available: Door Pivot Hinges for other manufactures.

Specifications: for Global TH1300 YKK Pivot Hinge

  • For metal & aluminum frame store front doors and doors up to 125 lbs.
  • Weather resistant
  • Die-cast aluminum case construction
  • Vertical adjustment 1/8"
  • Fully retractable, spring loaded top pin for easy installations
  • Full race ball bearing and oilite bronze bushing
  • No sag, entire weight of doors rests on floor mounted pivot portion
  • Completely temper proof, yet easily removable, replaceable in unlocked position
  • YKK Pivot Hinges are Handed - specify left handed or right handed when ordering
  • Available in two finishes: AL- Aluminum, or DU-Duronotic (Dark Bronze).
  • Sold as a set, top & bottom pivots with brackets (see image)
  • Global TH1300 Dimensions (PDF)

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this pivot hinge:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
